rationale: The revision now explicitly states two Boolean conditions: no candidate has a larger magnitude, and no earlier candidate has an equal magnitude. These are negated existential > and == comparisons, not the historical universal >= condition. Nonfinite handling remains unresolved but no executable guard restricts the domain. Check the literal relation with guard True; conditional future circuit feasibility and whole-plan equivalence remain unjudged.

interpretations.meaning: Literal no-larger and no-earlier-equal conditions on absolute pivot values.
interpretations.expression: not any(values[k] > values[i] for k in indices) and not any(values[j] == values[i] for j in indices if j < i)
